read_sections: III late fusion limitations and NMS omission
method_observations: Uses candidates before NMS and low confidence thresholds to avoid discarding correct detections.
Fuses same-category candidates using geometric IoU and native scores.
Learns a discriminative sparse pair fusion model for camera-LiDAR 3D detection.
paper.overlap: PreNMS inventories, low thresholds, cross-source geometric/semantic consistency and learned candidate fusion are prior art.
paper.unproved_possible_difference: A detector-shared multiview policy using observable suppression witnesses to distinguish suppression censoring from true absence could be a narrower question. Merely changing modality to views, adding a contrast term or renaming Soft-NMS is insufficient. Experiment22 fails FP budget.
